boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The College of New Jersey
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with publicly posted evening or overnight availability in Ewing.

cards.title: Ewing Diner
cards.subtitle: 1099 Parkway Avenue, Ewing
cards.notes: Check the day-specific dine-in or takeout schedule before leaving campus; overnight availability is posted for much of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Parkway Avenue diner with posted overnight service on select days.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Diner’s official contact page lists dine-in and takeout hours until 11 p.m. Monday and Tuesday and 24-hour service Wednesday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Contacts | Ewing Diner
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in and takeout service 24 hours Wednesday–Sunday; Monday and Tuesday close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Two Brothers Pizzeria & Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1690 Pennington Road, Ewing
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s ordering page to confirm the day before heading out; several posted takeout nights run past midnight.
cards.short_summary: Pennington Road pizzeria with late posted takeout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Two Brothers Pizzeria & Restaurant’s official ordering site lists takeout until 2 a.m. on Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday.
cards.source_title: Two Brothers Pizzeria & Restaurant | Official Ordering Site
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists takeout until 2 a.m. Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday; confirm current service before travel.

cards.title: Sonic Drive-In
cards.subtitle: 1660 North Olden Avenue, Ewing
cards.notes: Confirm the current ordering and drive-thru schedule before the trip, especially midweek when the posted closing time changes.
cards.short_summary: North Olden Avenue drive-in with late posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s current business listing reports Sonic Drive-In hours until midnight Sunday through Wednesday, 1 a.m. Thursday, and 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Food and Dining – Retail | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts service until midnight or later daily, including 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday; check before visiting.

cards.title: Sing Lee Chinese Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1512 North Olden Avenue, Ewing
cards.notes: Plan pickup around the listed evening window and confirm the current schedule directly before traveling from campus.
cards.short_summary: Chinese restaurant with Friday and Saturday service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s business page lists Sing Lee Chinese Restaurant open until 11 p.m. Monday through Thursday and midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sing Lee Chinese Restaurant | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts closing at midnight Friday and Saturday; confirm current pickup or dine-in availability first.

cards.title: Rosa Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1870 North Olden Avenue, Ewing
cards.notes: Check current pickup availability before leaving; the township’s listing identifies this as an especially late food option.
cards.short_summary: North Olden Avenue pizzeria with a posted 3 a.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s business listing states that Rosa Pizza is open daily from 11 a.m. to 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Food and Dining – Retail | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts daily hours through 3 a.m.; verify the restaurant’s current service status before going.

cards.title: Ruben's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 2191 Spruce Street, Ewing
cards.notes: Use the listed evening window for a planned pickup and check the current day’s availability before traveling off campus.
cards.short_summary: Spruce Street pizzeria with late weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s business listing gives Ruben’s Pizza closing times of 11 p.m. Friday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Food and Dining – Retail | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts service through 11 p.m. Friday–Sunday; confirm current pickup and delivery availability before leaving.

cards.title: Royal Chef
cards.subtitle: 1400 Parkway Avenue, Ewing
cards.notes: Confirm the current evening schedule before you go, then use the Parkway Avenue address for a pickup-focused dinner stop.
cards.short_summary: Parkway Avenue Chinese restaurant with a 10 p.m. posted close.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s business listing reports Royal Chef open from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Food and Dining – Retail | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts daily service until 10 p.m.; check the restaurant’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fu Wah
cards.subtitle: 1871 North Olden Avenue, Ewing
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule before departing, particularly on Friday or Saturday when the listed closing time is later.
cards.short_summary: North Olden Avenue Chinese restaurant with late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s business listing reports Fu Wah open until 10:45 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Food and Drink | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts a 10:45 p.m. Friday and Saturday close; confirm current ordering availability before travel.

cards.title: Bella Ciao Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 300 Main Boulevard East, Ewing
cards.notes: Check the live restaurant schedule before making a Campus Town pickup; the town’s listing reports an evening close every day.
cards.short_summary: Campus Town pizzeria with a daily posted 10 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s business listing states Bella Ciao Pizzeria is open daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Food and Dining – Retail | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts daily hours until 10 p.m.; verify the restaurant’s current availability before visiting.

cards.title: Asian Yummy Sushi
cards.subtitle: 600 Campus Town Drive, Ewing
cards.notes: Use the direct restaurant site to check the day’s pickup window; its Campus Town location is close to TCNJ.
cards.short_summary: Campus Town sushi restaurant with posted evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: Ewing Township’s business listing identifies Asian Yummy Sushi at 600 Campus Town Drive and posts service until 9:30 p.m. Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Food and Dining – Retail | Ewing Township
cards.access_notes: Township listing posts closing at 9:30 p.m. Monday–Saturday; confirm current service before walking or driving over.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus study and gathering destinations documented by TCNJ’s campus-planning, library, and student-life sources.

cards.title: Brower Student Center
cards.subtitle: Student center with study space and a game room
cards.notes: Start at the student center when you need a central meeting point; use its documented second-floor study space between activities or appointments.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub with services, activities, a game room, and designated study space.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ identifies Brower Student Center as a campus-community hub and its commuter map lists a game room and second-floor study space.
cards.source_title: Brower Student Center | Student Life
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Life page for current building hours and event-related room availability.

cards.title: Gitenstein Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, third floor
cards.notes: Reserve a third-floor room for a focused individual or small-group session; unreserved rooms on other listed floors remain first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: Reservable and walk-in study rooms within TCNJ’s five-story library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s study-room pilot makes nine third-floor rooms reservable for TCNJ students and identifies other floors as first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room (pilot) | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations are for TCNJ students; review the current pilot rules and library hours before planning a session.

cards.title: Biology Building Science Commons
cards.subtitle: Biology Building, rooms 103, 108, and 231
cards.notes: Use the listed Science Commons rooms as a between-class work stop; pair up for a problem set or spread out materials before lab.
cards.short_summary: Multiple designated study areas in the Biology Building.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory lists Science Commons 103, 108, and 231 in the Biology Building.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: These are campus study areas; follow posted building-access and room-use rules.

cards.title: Social Sciences Building Atrium
cards.subtitle: Social Sciences Building
cards.notes: Choose the atrium for a short collaborative check-in or reading break, then move along once your next class or scheduled activity begins.
cards.short_summary: A designated 14-seat study area in the Social Sciences Building.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory identifies the Social Sciences Building atrium as a 14-seat study area.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: Availability can vary with building access and nearby academic activity.

cards.title: STEM Building Open Commons L1
cards.subtitle: STEM Building, lower level
cards.notes: Bring a classmate to the lower-level commons for a working session; use headphones and keep pathways clear in this shared academic space.
cards.short_summary: One of several designated study areas in the STEM Building.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory lists Open Commons L1 among the STEM Building’s study locations.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to normal STEM Building access and posted room guidance.

cards.title: Chemistry Building Student Commons
cards.subtitle: Science Complex, Chemistry Building
cards.notes: Use the Chemistry Building’s documented commons for a quick review session before heading to class; respect any class or lab activity nearby.
cards.short_summary: A designated student commons in the Chemistry Building.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory lists a Student Commons on the first and second floors of the Chemistry Building.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: Follow building-access requirements and any posted laboratory safety restrictions.

cards.title: Art & IMM Student Lounge 112
cards.subtitle: Art & Interactive Multimedia Building, room 112
cards.notes: Stop in with a sketchbook or laptop for a short work block; the campus inventory identifies this lounge as a student study area.
cards.short_summary: A designated four-seat student lounge in Art & IMM.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory lists Student Lounge 112 in the Art & IMM Building with four seats.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: Room access and availability may change with classes or building operations.

cards.title: Education Building Student Lounge 309
cards.subtitle: Education Building, third floor
cards.notes: Use Lounge 309 for a small study session between Education Building commitments; leave the space ready for the next group.
cards.short_summary: A listed third-floor student lounge in the Education Building.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory identifies Student Lounge 309 on the third floor of the Education Building.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to current building access and any posted lounge guidance.

cards.title: Music Building Student Lounge 02
cards.subtitle: Music Building, lower level
cards.notes: Head to the lower-level student lounge when you need a seated work stop near music facilities; keep the shared area orderly.
cards.short_summary: A designated student lounge in the Music Building’s lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory lists Student Lounge 02 in the Music Building’s lower level.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: Building and lounge availability may be affected by classes, rehearsals, or events.

cards.title: Kendall Hall Backstage Lobby
cards.subtitle: Kendall Hall
cards.notes: Use the backstage lobby’s listed study seating for a brief reading or planning session, while giving scheduled performances and production work priority.
cards.short_summary: A designated four-seat study area inside Kendall Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s campus study-area inventory lists four study seats in the Kendall Hall Backstage Lobby.
cards.source_title: Campus Study Areas, 2021 | Campus Planning
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on current building access and backstage or event operations.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, no-admission activities at TCNJ and nearby public cultural destinations.

cards.title: Browse the TCNJ Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art & Interactive Multimedia Building · TCNJ
cards.notes: Meet up in the AIMM Building and take in the current exhibition at your own pace; check the gallery page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery visit with public, no-cost exhibition access.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ states that all Art Gallery exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: About the Gallery | TCNJ Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of TCNJ's Art & Interactive Multimedia Building; confirm current gallery hours before visiting.

cards.title: Catch an Art Gallery artist talk
cards.subtitle: TCNJ Art Gallery · AIMM Building
cards.notes: Use the gallery program calendar to choose an artist talk, then arrive with a friend early enough to settle in before it begins.
cards.short_summary: Public conversations connected to the gallery's exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ states that all Art Gallery artist talks are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: About the Gallery | TCNJ Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by exhibition; use the gallery calendar for dates and locations.

cards.title: Join a gallery learning program
cards.subtitle: TCNJ Art Gallery · AIMM Building
cards.notes: Look for a listed educational program and bring a classmate; the gallery identifies these programs as public and free to attend.
cards.short_summary: Hands-on or discussion-based programming at a named campus gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ states that all Art Gallery educational programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: About the Gallery | TCNJ Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Check the gallery's current programs listing for scheduling and any registration details.

cards.entity_name: The College of New Jersey Visiting Writers Series
cards.title: Listen at the Visiting Writers Series
cards.subtitle: TCNJ campus · hosted by the English Department
cards.notes: Pick an announced author event, invite someone to join you, and stay afterward if the program includes conversation or questions.
cards.short_summary: Public readings and author perspectives organized through TCNJ's Writing Communities course.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ says Visiting Writers Series events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: The College of New Jersey’s Visiting Writers Series
cards.access_notes: Dates and venues depend on the series schedule; consult the series page or English Department announcements.

cards.title: Attend a Black History Month program
cards.subtitle: TCNJ campus · annual program series
cards.notes: Review the published calendar for a talk, teach-in, or performance and use the listed registration details when an event requests them.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus series centered on Black and African American culture and history.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ reports that Black History Month events are free and open to the public unless otherwise noted.
cards.source_title: TCNJ celebrates Black History Month by honoring the power of Black expressionism
cards.access_notes: This is annual, scheduled programming; consult the current campus calendar because individual events may have registration details.

cards.title: Explore the State Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: 205 West State Street · Trenton, NJ
cards.notes: Plan a gallery-only visit with friends and skip ticketed planetarium shows if you want to keep the outing entirely free.
cards.short_summary: Free general-admission galleries covering New Jersey art, history, and natural history.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Jersey State Museum states that general admission is free.
cards.source_title: NJ State Museum — Visit, Plan Your Visit
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Tuesday–Sunday hours and notes that planetarium shows have separate paid admission.

cards.entity_name: New Jersey State Museum Guided Tours
cards.title: Take a State Museum guided tour
cards.subtitle: New Jersey State Museum · Trenton, NJ
cards.notes: Coordinate a group visit and request a guided tour in advance; build time afterward to revisit the galleries that caught your attention.
cards.short_summary: A reserved museum-tour option with documented free pricing.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Jersey State Museum lists guided tours as free and requires advance reservations for programs.
cards.source_title: NJ State Museum — Learn
cards.access_notes: Advance reservations are required for in-person programs; contact the museum before making plans.

cards.title: Tour the New Jersey State House
cards.subtitle: New Jersey State House · Trenton, NJ
cards.notes: Choose a weekday visit, bring photo identification if requested by security, and reserve ahead when organizing a larger group.
cards.short_summary: A free guided look at New Jersey's working State House.
cards.evidence_claim: New Jersey's official tourism page says the public can participate in free State House tours on weekdays.
cards.source_title: Explore NJ | NJ.gov
cards.access_notes: Free weekday tours are listed by NJ.gov; verify current security, scheduling, and reservation requirements with the State House Tour Office.

cards.title: Spend a day at the Cultural Festival
cards.subtitle: Mercer County Park · West Windsor, NJ
cards.notes: Make a daytime plan around the music, dance, and traditional-art demonstrations, and check the county page for weather or schedule updates.
cards.short_summary: A one-day county festival featuring live performance and cultural demonstrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer County describes its 2026 Cultural Festival at Mercer County Park as free.
cards.source_title: Cultural Festival | Mercer County, NJ
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for June 6, 2026; review the county's event page before travel for current details.

cards.title: Cool off at the Spray Park
cards.subtitle: Mercer County Park · West Windsor, NJ
cards.notes: Bring water-safe clothing and arrive early for an attendant-issued time slot; plan for the posted 45-minute session structure.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor spray-park outing with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer County states that admission to the Mercer County Park Spray Park is free.
cards.source_title: Spray Park Information | Mercer County, NJ
cards.access_notes: At 1638 Old Trenton Road; seasonal, weather-dependent hours apply, with a 60-person capacity and attendant-issued access tickets.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten library and campus study environments with documented noise designations, room rules, or after-hours access details.

cards.entity_name: Gitenstein Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Set up in the non-central portion of Level 3 when silent open seating suits your work; keep collaboration for the designated rooms and central area.
cards.short_summary: A silent open-study zone on the library’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ designates the third floor outside its central reading area and group study rooms as a Quiet Study Area, where open areas are silent.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: TCNJ ID or mobile credential is required after 6 PM on weekdays and for all weekend hours.

cards.entity_name: Gitenstein Library Fourth-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Fourth-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 4
cards.notes: Bring solo reading or writing to Level 4’s quiet open area; use one of the group rooms instead if your work needs conversation.
cards.short_summary: The library’s floor-wide quiet-study setting, apart from its group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ designates the entire fourth floor of Gitenstein Library as a Quiet Study Area, with group study rooms treated as collaborative areas.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: TCNJ ID or mobile credential is required after 6 PM on weekdays and for all weekend hours.

cards.title: Third-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Reserve a room for an individual session or a small-group project, and plan around the pilot’s daily and weekly reservation limits.
cards.short_summary: Nine reservable Level 3 rooms for individual or small-group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Nine third-floor study rooms are available for reservation by individual TCNJ students or small groups under a pilot program.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room (pilot) | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: For TCNJ students; reservations may be made up to one week ahead, up to three hours daily and six hours weekly.

cards.title: Second-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Use these rooms for collaborative academic work on a first-come basis; groups of two or more have preference, so arrive together.
cards.short_summary: First-come library rooms intended for collaborative schoolwork.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms on the second floor are first-come, first-served; TCNJ restricts their use to students, faculty, and staff and gives groups of two or more preference.
cards.source_title: Study Room Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: Not reservable; intended for academic work. A single user may be asked to move when a group needs the room.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 4
cards.notes: Choose a fourth-floor room for a small project session, then reset the furniture neatly and leave the room clean when you finish.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative rooms embedded within the library’s quietest floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth-floor group study rooms are Collaborative Learning Areas, while the rest of the floor is designated for quiet study; second- and fourth-floor rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Study Room Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served for TCNJ students, faculty, and staff; groups of two or more have preference.

cards.title: Reference Room
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Use the Reference Room when you need a collaborative setting close to library support; keep conversation muted and plan research questions in advance.
cards.short_summary: A Level 1 collaborative learning area near library services.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ identifies the Reference Room on the first floor as a Collaborative Learning Area, where muted conversation is permitted in open areas.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: Library Reference Services is located on Level 1; building access after 6 PM weekdays and on weekends requires TCNJ credentials or guest assistance.

cards.title: Lower Lobby
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Lower Level
cards.notes: Check whether an event or class is scheduled before settling in; when neither is using the lobby, it is designated for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level space that becomes quiet study when not programmed.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ designates the Lower Lobby as Quiet Study when classes or events are not scheduled there.
cards.source_title: Noise Policy | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: During final exams, the library sets up tables and chairs in the Lower Lobby for additional study space.

cards.title: Library Instruction Labs
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Lower Level
cards.notes: Use a lab for computer-based work when no class or event is scheduled; after closing, enter the Extended Study Area through the south door with ID.
cards.short_summary: Two lower-level labs available as part of the library’s after-hours study area.
cards.evidence_claim: Both Library Instruction Labs are part of Gitenstein Library’s Extended Study Area after the library closes, and are Quiet Study when no class or event is scheduled.
cards.source_title: Extended Study Area | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: After library closing, access is through the south entry door and requires a valid TCNJ ID card.

cards.title: Arcade Room
cards.subtitle: R. Barbara Gitenstein Library, Main Level
cards.notes: Use this Level 1 option for collaborative coursework, especially if your schedule runs beyond normal library closing; bring your TCNJ ID for later entry.
cards.short_summary: A main-level collaborative area included in after-hours library access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arcade Room on Gitenstein Library’s Main Level is included in the Extended Study Area after the library closes; the Extended Study Area is a Collaborative Learning Area.
cards.source_title: Extended Study Area | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: After library closing, enter through the south entry door using a valid TCNJ ID card.

cards.entity_name: Brower Student Center Collaborative Study Spaces
cards.title: Brower Student Center Collaborative Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Clayton R. Brower Student Center
cards.notes: Use the student center’s collaborative study areas when your work benefits from an open lounge setting; check building operations before planning a group meet-up.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study areas within TCNJ’s renovated student center.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ states that the renovated Brower Student Center includes collaborative study spaces, alongside lounges, meeting areas, and dining facilities.
cards.source_title: Brower Student Center History | Student Life
cards.access_notes: The source documents collaborative study spaces but does not specify individual room access or reservation rules.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented TCNJ traditions and recurring campus rituals, from first-year welcome programming to senior send-off.

cards.entity_name: Rubbing the William M. McLagan ’87 Lion’s Nose
cards.title: Boop Roscoe’s Nose
cards.subtitle: Finals-week luck ritual at the Brower Student Center
cards.notes: Find the bronze William M. McLagan ’87 Lion beside Brower Student Center and give its nose a respectful rub before a test or presentation.
cards.short_summary: A new TCNJ luck ritual centers on the bronze lion’s nose.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ documented the 2024 launch of a tradition in which students rub the bronze lion’s nose for luck before finals and other milestones.
cards.source_title: The start of a proud new TCNJ tradition
cards.access_notes: The sculpture is next to the Brower Student Center; treat the artwork carefully.

cards.title: Start With Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: Five-day transition tradition for new TCNJ students
cards.notes: New first-year and transfer students can use the Welcome Week schedule to orient themselves, meet peers, and learn campus expectations.
cards.short_summary: Welcome Week is TCNJ’s culminating transition program for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ calls Welcome Week a long-standing tradition and describes it as a five-day program with more than 100 mandatory and optional events for new students.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week – Student Transitions
cards.access_notes: Designed for newly enrolled first-year and transfer students; follow current Student Transitions instructions.

cards.title: Join First-Year Face-Off
cards.subtitle: Residence-hall community tradition for first-year students
cards.notes: If you live in a First-Year Experience hall, check with residential staff for current FYFO events and ways to earn points with your community.
cards.short_summary: FYFO connects first-year residence halls through teamwork and programming.
cards.evidence_claim: A TCNJ Housing brochure identifies First-Year Face-Off as a longstanding TCNJ tradition featuring events, healthy competition, teamwork, and Lion Pride.
cards.source_title: Accepted Students Day: Virtual Brochure
cards.access_notes: Participation is associated with First-Year Experience residence halls; event formats may change by year.

cards.title: Wear the Blue and Gold
cards.subtitle: Annual TCNJ spirit tradition
cards.notes: Watch current campus announcements for Spirit Week activities, then choose a listed event where you can show TCNJ’s blue-and-gold school spirit.
cards.short_summary: Spirit Week is one of the recurring traditions TCNJ highlights for campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ identifies Spirit Week among its major annual traditions that foster community spirit.
cards.source_title: Entertainment and Area Guide – Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Check the current campus calendar for dates, locations, and participation details.

cards.title: Return for Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Fall celebration for students, families, and alumni
cards.notes: Use TCNJ’s current Homecoming and Family Day information to select public events and plan campus arrival, parking, and any needed registration.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming brings the TCNJ community together in the fall.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ describes Homecoming as a major annual fall celebration for students, families, and alumni.
cards.source_title: Entertainment and Area Guide – Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Individual Homecoming activities can have separate registration or ticket requirements.

cards.title: Catch the Spring Funival
cards.subtitle: TCNJ’s annual spring carnival
cards.notes: Look for the College Union Board’s current Funival announcement and review entry details before heading to the spring carnival activities.
cards.short_summary: Funival is TCNJ’s recurring spring carnival tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ identifies Funival as a springtime carnival tradition; a 2026 college newsletter calls it the College Union Board’s annual Funival.
cards.source_title: Inside The Lions Den, May 2026
cards.access_notes: Dates, location, and admission arrangements vary by year; confirm the current event listing.

cards.title: Mark Senior Send-Off by the Lake
cards.subtitle: Graduating-senior celebration before commencement
cards.notes: Eligible graduating seniors should watch Student Life and class communications for current registration, timing, and event guidance before attending.
cards.short_summary: Last Night on the Lake is TCNJ’s senior-year closing celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ describes Last Night on the Lake as a tradition in which graduating seniors mark their final days on campus; Student Affairs documented it as a senior celebration before commencement.
cards.source_title: Entertainment and Area Guide – Campus Life
cards.access_notes: This event is intended for graduating seniors; confirm current eligibility and registration details.

cards.title: Observe Founders’ Day
cards.subtitle: Annual February 9 TCNJ history observance
cards.notes: Use current college announcements to find Founders’ Day programming and connect the February 9 observance with TCNJ’s institutional history.
cards.short_summary: Founders’ Day is an annual TCNJ observance established during its sesquicentennial.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ archival material states that an annual Founders’ Day celebration on February 9 was established during the sesquicentennial.
cards.source_title: The College of New Jersey Sesquicentennial archival publication
cards.access_notes: Programming is event-dependent; consult current college communications for any public observance.

cards.title: Spot the Cardboard Regatta
cards.subtitle: TCNJ rite listed in the college’s traditions record
cards.notes: Check current college and student-organization listings for any Cardboard Regatta iteration, and follow only the event’s posted safety and participation rules.
cards.short_summary: The Cardboard Regatta is recorded among TCNJ’s rites and traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s official “Rites & Traditions” publication includes Cardboard Regatta among its campus traditions.
cards.source_title: Rites & Traditions
cards.access_notes: No current event schedule was verified; do not enter water or participate without official event supervision.

cards.title: Meet Zooner’s Visiting Animals
cards.subtitle: Zoo-plus-nooner campus event
cards.notes: Look for a current Zooner listing, then attend the planned animal encounter from designated public areas and follow staff directions around animals.
cards.short_summary: Zooner is TCNJ’s named animal-visitor event.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ’s official “Rites & Traditions” publication defines Zooner as an event bringing animals such as sloths, llamas, hedgehogs, and reptiles to campus.
cards.source_title: Rites & Traditions
cards.access_notes: Animal lineup and scheduling are event-specific; follow current host guidance and animal-handling rules.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at The College of New Jersey, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend route through campus resources, activity spaces, art, and nearby Campus Town.

cards.title: Start at Brower Student Center
cards.subtitle: Orientation and campus-information hub
cards.notes: Begin in the atrium, then use the building as your anchor while you learn routes, find events, and meet up with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: A central starting point for getting oriented on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ identifies Brower Student Center as the heart of the campus community, with services, activities, and event support.
cards.source_title: Brower Student Center | Student Life
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Life page for current building information and events.

cards.title: Ask the Information Desk
cards.subtitle: First floor of Brower Student Center
cards.notes: Bring one practical question—directions, campus services, a phone number, or an event—and leave with a clearer next stop for the day.
cards.short_summary: A staffed place to turn a vague question into a campus plan.
cards.evidence_claim: The first-floor Information Desk provides campus-resource information, directions, event information, lost and found, and game-room equipment sign-out.
cards.source_title: Information Desk | Student Life
cards.access_notes: Located on Brower Student Center's first floor; call 609-771-2331 for assistance.

cards.title: Take a game-room break
cards.subtitle: Brower Student Center
cards.notes: After unpacking or a campus walk, borrow available equipment through the Information Desk and make this a short, easygoing group activity.
cards.short_summary: A casual indoor reset built into the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ's Information Desk is the primary location for signing out Brower Student Center game-room equipment.
cards.source_title: Information Desk | Student Life
cards.access_notes: Ask the Information Desk about equipment availability and current game-room access.

cards.title: Find a library landing spot
cards.subtitle: On the quad, east of Green Hall
cards.notes: Walk through the five-story library, identify a study floor, and save the location of a group room for your first collaborative assignment.
cards.short_summary: A campus study stop with rooms, collections, and a café.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has 26 group study rooms, a café, a late-night study area, and a multipurpose auditorium.
cards.source_title: About the Library | R. Barbara Gitenstein Library
cards.access_notes: Library services and spaces are for the TCNJ community; consult its current hours before visiting.

cards.title: See the Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art and Interactive Multimedia Building
cards.notes: Use the current exhibition as a quiet conversation starter; read the entry material, take in the work, and check the gallery calendar before you go.
cards.short_summary: A rotating campus-gallery stop near the main entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ states that its Art Gallery is in the Art and Interactive Multimedia Building next to Trenton Hall.
cards.source_title: Visit | TCNJ Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Review gallery hours before visiting; weekend parking information is provided on the gallery's visit page.

cards.title: Move at the Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation and wellness facility
cards.notes: Bring your current TCNJ ID, scan the open-rec schedule, and choose a low-commitment activity such as the indoor track or court recreation.
cards.short_summary: An ID-accessed activity stop with courts, track, and wellness spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Recreation Center includes basketball, tennis, racquetball, volleyball facilities, an indoor track, and a dance studio.
cards.source_title: Recreation Center | Student Life
cards.access_notes: A current TCNJ ID is required; the page lists weekday building hours through 11:00 p.m. and weekend hours through 8:00 p.m.

cards.title: Walk through Quimby's Prairie
cards.subtitle: Open campus landscape near Kendall Hall
cards.notes: Use this named green space as a daylight walking stop between campus buildings; pause to orient yourself with the nearby performance and academic areas.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed lawn area for a simple campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ's Center for the Arts campus map labels Quimby's Prairie as a named campus destination.
cards.source_title: TCNJ Center for the Arts Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Use established paths and the current campus map; this is an outdoor stop best suited to daylight and suitable weather.

cards.title: Locate Kendall Hall Main Stage
cards.subtitle: Kendall Hall, Center for the Arts venue
cards.notes: Find the main-stage entrance during daylight, then check the Center for the Arts calendar later when you want to plan a ticketed or campus event.
cards.short_summary: A named performance venue to place on your mental campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ's Center for the Arts campus map identifies Kendall Hall Main Stage as a venue.
cards.source_title: TCNJ Center for the Arts Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Event access, tickets, and opening times vary; confirm them with the presenting venue before attending.

cards.title: Plan a meal at The Atrium
cards.subtitle: Eickhoff Hall dining hub
cards.notes: Use the main dining hub to coordinate a meal with your floor or orientation group, then note the other campus food options for a future visit.
cards.short_summary: A practical meal-and-meet stop for a first campus weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ identifies The Atrium at Eickhoff as its main dining hub.
cards.source_title: Housing and Dining | Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Meal access depends on an applicable meal plan or other payment method; consult Dining Services for current details.

cards.title: End with a Campus Town walk
cards.subtitle: Privately managed community adjacent to campus
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk through the adjacent retail area, noting useful services and dining options without treating a purchase as part of the plan.
cards.short_summary: An adjacent, walkable retail-and-residential area.
cards.evidence_claim: TCNJ describes Campus Town as a privately managed residential community located adjacent to campus.
cards.source_title: First Year Housing Requirement | Residential Education, Housing, and Dining
cards.access_notes: Campus Town operates separately from TCNJ housing; individual businesses set their own access and purchase terms.
